en.headline: Hong Kong writer Lawrence Pun dies at 56 after fall from North Point flat
en.dek: Police found a note at the writer’s residence indicating prolonged illness; Pun had battled thymoma and related complications since 2023 and published a final essay collection last month.
body: Renowned Hong Kong writer and cultural critic Lawrence Pun Kwok-ling, 56, died on Wednesday morning after falling from his flat at Kar On House on Cheung Hong Street in North Point.

Police received a report around 5:25 am after a security guard heard a loud noise and found the man lying unconscious on the road outside the Education University of Hong Kong’s North Point Study Centre. He was taken to Eastern Hospital and pronounced dead at 5:53 am.

Officers found a note at the flat. The case was treated as a suicide related to long-term illness and referred to the North Point miscellaneous investigation team. Pun had lived alone and suffered from thymoma diagnosed in early 2023, followed by surgery, radiotherapy and later autoimmune complications that affected speech, balance and mobility.

He continued writing through his illness. His most recent prose collection, described by him as likely his final book, was published last month. Pun previously worked as a journalist and editor and taught at universities while producing novels, essays and criticism that earned local literary awards.

zh.headline: 香港作家潘國靈北角寓所墮樓身亡 終年56歲
zh.dek: 警方在單位檢獲遺書，指事主長期受病患困擾；潘國靈自2023年確診胸腺瘤後接受手術及電療，上月剛出版新書。
body: 本港著名作家及文化評論人潘國靈（56歲）周三早上在北角長康街嘉安苑寓所墮樓，送院後不治。
警方於清晨約5時25分接報，保安員聽到巨響後發現男子昏迷倒臥長康街香港教育大學北角教學中心對開馬路，送東區醫院搶救，至5時53分證實死亡。
警員在單位檢獲遺書，案件列作因病尋死處理，交北角警區雜項調查隊跟進。潘國靈獨居，2023年初確診胸腺瘤，其後接受開胸手術及多次放射治療，並出現自體免疫相關併發症，影響說話、平衡及行動。
他患病期間仍堅持創作，上月出版散文集，自形容大概是生命最後之書。潘國靈早年曾任記者及編輯，並在大學任教，作品涵蓋小說、散文及評論，曾獲多項本地文學獎項。
